title: Split-Focus Sidebar: Progressive Workspace Lenses & Sticky Route Anchors
creator: Maya Patel
description: Design and prototype a 'split-focus' sidebar pattern that surfaces progressive workspace lenses and sticky route anchors to help users quickly orient across dashboards, rollouts, and cost views. The goal is to reduce context switching cost, improve discoverability of cost lenses and rollout states, and make workspace switching predictable across small and large organizations.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates persistent left rail with two focus planes: global workspace controls and contextual lens strip
Users can switch workspaces with <2 interactions from any primary dashboard view
Cost lens entry points are visible on at least three dashboard types (overview, per-model, rollouts) in the prototype
Sticky route anchors persist scroll position across workspace previews and maintain user's selected lens
Hand-off artifacts (Figma frames, interaction spec, token list) provided to eng and PM with clear CSS/layout guidance
Accessibility: keyboard navigation order documented; high-contrast and screen-reader label examples included
design_notes: Split-focus = fixed vertical column for workspace/session controls (top) + contextual lens strip (bottom) that expands on hover/focus
Introduce 'sticky anchors' as a micro-state that remembers the sub-route (e.g., dashboards > cost > token-breakdown) when switching back to a workspace
Lens strip shows lightweight badges for 'cost', 'rollouts', 'health', and 'recent maps' with usage-based prioritization (promote cost for high spend orgs)
Use tokenized spacing and layout tokens from brand system; propose compact and roomy modes for different density preferences
Progressive disclosure: show icons only at narrow width, reveal label on hover/focus to avoid overwhelming new users
Avoid modal-style workspace switching; prefer inline workspace preview panel to maintain context
review_feedback: PM (Ava Martinez): prioritise cost-lens discoverability on high-spend routes; show spend delta inline
Eng (Liam Chen): confirm performance budget for sticky anchors — must not add >10ms to route switch path; request simplified DOM structure
Security (Ruth O'Connor): confirm no additional surface for cross-workspace tokens; workspace preview must respect RBAC
Design lead (Sofia Reyes): suggest stronger affordance for active lens and clearer separation between workspace selector and lens strip
Accessibility reviewer (Jon Park): keyboard focus trap present in current prototype; needs linear focus order and aria-live for anchor changes
changes_requested: Tweak prototype to use reduced DOM layering and fewer absolute positioned elements per Eng feedback
Add explicit RBAC check markers to preview cards and call out in spec per Security
Improve keyboard sash control: allow arrow keys to navigate lenses and Enter to expand per Accessibility notes
Show spend delta pill on cost lens badge and surface a tooltip with timeframe selection
Add micro-analytics hooks for 'workspace switch latency' and 'lens open rate' to inform rollout
decisions: Adopt split-focus two-plane left rail as preferred IA pattern for upcoming console release
Implement sticky anchors as a client-side lightweight state (localStorage + telemetry) with opt-out for Dedicated/Private deployments
Expose an admin toggle in settings to prioritize lenses by org spend (PM to drive threshold)
usability_test_findings: Study of 12 participants: median time to locate cost breakdown dropped from 14s -> 6s with split-focus
Participants liked inline previews; a minority found strip labels ambiguous at first glance
Users requested clearer distinction between 'workspace' and 'lens' actions; we added a subtle divider and microcopy
Several users attempted to drag reorder workspaces — record as potential roadmap feature
next_steps: Address requested changes and update Figma frames by 2026-03-18
Schedule design->eng handoff workshop with ENG-2211 and ENG-3178 on 2026-03-20
Prepare A/B test plan for canary rollout focusing on 'cost lens click-through' and 'workspace switch latency' metrics
Create QA checklist for accessibility and RBAC scenarios
Add telemetry events: workspace_switch_initiated, workspace_switch_complete, lens_opened, anchor_restored
